`tessera-sx40-3.5.2.json` is a real Tessera SX40 (software 3.5.2) answering `GET /api/` on 2026-11-12, trimmed to the
parts the driver reads (colour, processing, groups and marker settings left out; values unchanged). Read-only capture.

`coex-cx40pro-5g.json` is a real NovaStar CX40 Pro with 5G output ports (20 cabinets of 320 × 320 on outputs 256, 258
and 260) answering the driver's GETs on 2026-11-12, one key per request (`output` is `GET /api/v1/screen/output`).
Trimmed: device fields the driver does not read and the device's password are left out; every cabinet is kept. Read-only.
